Game Overview

Flappy Bounce is a snake title where guide a nimble bouncing ball through perilous obstacle courses in Flappy Bounce. Test your precision and patience as you click to keep the ball aloft, while maneuvering through gaps and avoiding spikes. It's a deceptively simple yet maddeningly addictive challenge that promises to keep you striving for a new high score.
